description: 橋梁・河川構造物の強震観測記録 [roads, bridges and tunnels and dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都建設局. 【東京都建設局】 2011年東北地方太平洋沖地震における都の橋梁・水門等の強震記録(施設及び近傍地盤の加速度波形データ). Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都建設局. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
